title: Ruby Is ALIVE After 13 Months! First Fire Up, 2-Step Check & Dyno
coverage: full transcript read (0:00-23:23+). 0:00-1:30 is a sponsor read (no car data).

notes.fact: Ruby returned to service as-is (not the planned bigger 'Ruby 2.0' build) using Leroy's former engine, plus her old intake and old turbo kit; new wiring and plumbing
Side segment: shop F-150 with Coyote + Whipple pulled for a crank support (front of crank snout broken); 'Mullet' gets a new rear end with TBM rotors

cars.owner_driver: Cleetus McFarland team (Zach wiring, Ty fab, Jackson, Dr. Tune-them-all tuning)

base_vehicle.note: Corvette per series title/context; model/year not stated in this transcript

engine.family: LS-based (caption mentions LS-style features; family not explicitly named here)
engine.origin: Leroy's old engine; said to have run 7.01 in Leroy with a stick-shift trans
engine.notes: Called a 'used engine'; oil pan swapped to Ruby's pan months earlier

ignition.crank_trigger: MSD crank-trigger pickup (forced alternator relocation, new bracket by Ty)

power_adder.boost_psi_runs: 5-11 psi on dyno; spring ~5 psi + 1 psi on dome

fuel.type: E85 / E90 (ethanol only; methanol not needed for target)
fuel.system: separate E85 race system in rear; stock tanks for street

ecu.dash: Holley Pro Dash on Revision Race Works carbon-fiber 3D-printed mount (caption 'reversion race works')
ecu.boost_control: dome pressure via boost controller (commanded 12, saw 11)

transmission.type: automatic with trans brake (type not named)

electrical.fact: Entire harness redone into one side, split-loom; new button panel incl. cool-down button (water pump/intercooler fans), turn signals, hazards, under-glow

dyno.note: caption '1,2 horsepowers'; goal of 1,000 met; breaking up on the way up

fluid_checks.fact: Oil pressure ~37 psi after fix (idle); ~61-62 psi at speed, crew cites 7 psi per 1,000 rpm rule (~49 needed)

failures.cause: remote filter lines plumbed backwards -> zero oil pressure for ~7-10 s at first fire; fixed, no apparent damage
old patched harness caused misfire/cut-out gremlins

targets.et: 8.50s (caption '850s'), possibly faster; 'a six' floated with automatic (low confidence)

failure_modes: reversed remote oil filter lines -> zero oil pressure
